_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Is there an MCP server for Unity? I want Claude to be able to see my scene.
The unity-mcp bridge keeps dropping every time I hit Play. What's going on?
Run the EditMode tests for my game project from the command line.
expectations: the unity-agent-mcp skill is not invoked (unity-agent-cli's job)

evals.prompt: Set up the Todoist MCP connector for me.
expectations: the unity-agent-mcp skill is not invoked (not Unity)

evals.prompt: Which Unity MCP servers could work for this project, and which ones are ruled out? Check the actual project path and Unity version before answering.
expectations: the skill read ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt or ran the probe / `unity pipeline list` before recommending, proven by the tool call
evals.baseline: 2026-09-06: without the skill a fresh session listed CoplayDev and IvanMurzak from memory, did not mention the official `unity mcp`, and did not check the path-with-spaces constraint.

evals.prompt: Recommend one Unity MCP route for Claude Code on this project and give me the exact register command.
expectations: the reply names the official `unity mcp` route and gives a register command: `claude mcp add` (local scope) with `unity mcp --project-path`, or `unity mcp configure claude-code`
the reply says the Pipeline package must be installed first and that this edits Packages/manifest.json

evals.prompt: The unity MCP server is registered. Prove the client can actually see its tools.
expectations: a listing of the server's tools actually ran (`claude mcp list` or the MCP Inspector CLI with tools/list), proven by the tool call
